findings.detail: An upstream lookup that fails without returning data becomes a successful empty result through `|| true`. The empty-latest branch records no unavailable state. When no other surface contributes drift, the script exits successfully with empty stdout, and its companion workflow closes the existing drift issue as cleared despite the incomplete audit. Exposing stderr does not prevent that action. Pre-existing at the immutable base e8667c85610d10882e7c33078748c7113b1c4a8e; previously recorded as Important in Nit batch 4 and deferred in the ledger. Severity retained.
findings.evidence: At lines 206-211, failed curl becomes empty latest followed by a successful return. At lines 742-744, print_report emits nothing when drift_rows is empty. version-audit-workflow-template.yml interprets empty stdout as has_drift=false and closes an open audit issue. The same failure-to-empty control flow exists in the other runtime and registry lookup paths.
findings.title: Absent or partial data: upstream failures still become a no-drift success

findings.detail: A Copilot concern in comment position 21 through 100 of an unresolved Copilot-opened thread is omitted by both retrieval paths. fetch returns only the first 20 comments, while audit indexes the first 100 and treats their membership in that thread as proof that fetch covers them. The fetch output includes no nested pagination metadata to identify a longer thread for the documented manual fallback. Pre-existing at the immutable base e8667c85610d10882e7c33078748c7113b1c4a8e; previously recorded as Important in Nit batch 4 and deferred in the ledger. Severity retained.
findings.evidence: do_fetch requests comments(first: 20) at line 241. fetch_thread_index requests comments(first: 100) at line 646. do_parse_audit indexes those comments at lines 555-564, then emits no uncovered entry for an indexed comment in a Copilot-opened thread at lines 575-584. Thus a concern appearing only in comment 21 is neither fetched nor reported as uncovered.
findings.title: Parallel paths: the audit hides replies beyond the fetcher's comment cap
